spike_cosim.doc: Checks every retire record of a single-hart heliodor against spike.

params.name: CONFIG
params.doc: UDB architecture configuration spike is built from.

params.name: TRIGGERS
params.doc: Trigger count when the core differs from the configuration's (W4).

params.name: TOHOST_PA
params.doc: PA of tohost: the comparison ends after the first store to it.

spike_cosim_smp.doc:
Checks every retire record of a multi-hart heliodor against spike harts
sharing one memory.

ports.name: rec
ports.doc:
Every hart's retire lanes, concatenated: lane l of hart t is element
t * lanes + l, element 0 in the low bits.

ports.name: irq
ports.doc:
Every hart's retire_pkg::IrqEvent, concatenated, hart 0 in the low
bits. Its width sets the hart count.

params.name: CONFIG
params.doc: UDB architecture configuration spike is built from.

params.name: TRIGGERS
params.doc: Trigger count when the core differs from the configuration's (W4).

params.name: TOHOST_PA
params.doc:
PA of tohost: the comparison ends after the first store to it by any
hart.
